Maria H: Quick sync — NL region playbook for Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need final owners, remaining blockers, and one-line confirmations. TL;DR: routing policy, KMS test key, DB replica lag, DNS TTL, canary plan.
Kevin L: I can own routing policy + LB config. PR infra#987 ready, will merge after Julia's review.
Julia P: I’ll review tonight. Q: do we want session affinity for dedicated customers in wave1?
Maria H: Prefer no affinity for initial rollout. Kevin, add header-based tenant pinning as a later follow-up.
Samir: DB replica lag monitoring is in place, alert at 5s. Manual sync test gave avg 0.8s. If >3s during canary, fallback to eu-west.
Raj S: KMS handshake — we need a test CMK in nl for residency validation. Ashley, can SecOps create a limited test key?
Ashley C: SecOps will create `nl-test-kms` with tight policy and short expiry for testing. Ticket IR-3412 opened, ETA EOD Thu.
ops-bot: Ticket IR-3412 created and assigned to Ashley C. Reminder: run `kms-check` hook after key provisioned.
Samir: Quick ping: eng-runtime#4523 changes KV cache TTL and is blocking canary. @Julia P or @Kevin L can you do a quick CR?
Julia P: I’ll take the runtime CR after I finish the routing review.
Kevin L: Happy to help with CR if Julia is busy. Also DNS action: set TTL->60s at 22:00 UTC Thu. Network team notified.
Maria H: Routing fallback example — include explicit fallbacks in policy and keep warmers on during canary:
```
route:
  - priority: 1
    region: nl
  - priority: 2
    region: eu-west
    fallback: true
```
Maria H: Also need canary metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, DB lag, cost delta. Samir, can you own dashboards?
Samir: Confirming dashboard and alert wiring for canary, will post links once finalized.
Ashley C: Compliance note — run a residency audit during the canary window, I’ll coordinate with Compliance and SecOps.
Raj S: Confirming I own KMS handshake and dataflow tests (end-to-end).
Kevin L: Confirming routing/LB owner.
Julia P: Confirming CR review window tonight.
Samir: Confirming DB checks + canary metrics owner.
Ashley C: Confirming SecOps ticket + audit coordination.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for Fri 02:15 UTC (job id: canary-nl-214000).
Maria H: Final ask — everyone post a one-line confirmation before EOD Thu with the item you own. I’ll compile the cutover checklist and send runbook. :thumbsup:
